fields.statement: At 561ecd015 I read the diff: setup() in cmd/rhiza/main_test.go now calls checkWorkOutsideRepo(env.WorkDir) before anything else; it resolves symlinks and walks ancestors, failing on a .git path element, an ancestor holding .git (work tree), or a bare-repo dir (HEAD+objects+refs), with errors naming the path and 'set GOTMPDIR outside the repository'. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestCheckWorkOutsideRepo|TestScripts/ci-install' -v -count=1 with GOTMPDIR in my scratchpad: TestCheckWorkOutsideRepo/work_tree, /git_dir, /bare_repo (errors containing GOTMPDIR and the path) and /outside (nil) PASS, TestScripts/ci-install PASS. Run with the run's own GOTMPDIR under ~/code/rhiza/.git/rhiza/runs/.../tmp, ci-install fails before running with 'testscript $WORK $WORK is inside a git dir: set GOTMPDIR outside the repository', so the guard fires in the real case. Note: testscript's log rewrites the work dir to $WORK, so the printed path reads '$WORK' rather than the absolute path; the error itself carries the real path.
